q: तमिल साहित्य और कविता में उत्कृष्ट योगदान के लिए प्रतिष्ठित 60वें ज्ञानपीठ पुरस्कार से किसे सम्मानित किया गया?
e: Renowned Tamil poet and lyricist R. Vairamuthu received the 60th Jnanpith Award. (प्रसिद्ध तमिल कवि आर. वैरामुथु को 60वाँ ज्ञानपीठ पुरस्कार प्रदान किया गया।) Exam Boosters: (1) The Jnanpith Award is India's highest literary honour, instituted in 1961 (first awarded in 1965 to G. Sankara Kurup for Malayalam). (2) The 58th Jnanpith Award (2023) was jointly awarded to Gulzar (Urdu) and Jagadguru Rambhadracharya (Sanskrit).
qe: Who was honoured with the prestigious 60th Jnanpith Award for his outstanding contribution to Tamil literature and poetry?

q: सतत जैविक कृषि प्रमाणन के अंतर्गत कौन-सा केंद्र शासित प्रदेश भारत का पहला "जैविक केंद्र शासित प्रदेश" (Organic UT) बना?
e: Ladakh achieved the distinction of becoming India's first Organic Union Territory through zero-chemical traditional mountain agriculture and organic certification. (लद्दाख भारत का पहला जैविक केंद्र शासित प्रदेश बना।) Exam Boosters: (1) Sikkim became India's first 100% organic State in 2016. (2) Ladakh became a separate Union Territory without a legislature on 31 October 2019.
qe: Which Union Territory became India's first "Organic Union Territory" under sustainable organic farming certification?

q: रसायन विज्ञान का नोबेल पुरस्कार 2026 फ्रांस के हेनरी बी. कागन और जापान के केंसो सोआई को संयुक्त रूप से किस खोज के लिए दिया गया?
o: असममित कार्बनिक संश्लेषण में अरैखिक प्रभाव व स्व-उत्प्रेरण
e: Henri B. Kagan and Kenso Soai won the 2026 Chemistry Nobel for pioneering non-linear effects and asymmetric autocatalysis (Soai reaction), crucial to pharmaceutical chirality and origin-of-homochirality research.
qe: The 2026 Nobel Prize in Chemistry was jointly awarded to Henri B. Kagan (France) and Kenso Soai (Japan) for their discoveries in:
oe: Non-linear effects and autocatalysis in asymmetric organic synthesis

q: नवंबर 2026 में भारत का पहला प्रमाणित जैविक मत्स्य पालन क्लस्टर बनने वाला सोरेंग किस राज्य का जिला है?
e: Soreng district in Sikkim became India's first Organic Fisheries Cluster in November 2026, promoting chemical-free, eco-friendly cold-water aquaculture.
qe: Soreng, which became India's first certified Organic Fisheries Cluster in November 2026, is a district of:

q: उत्तर प्रदेश के किस उच्च शिक्षण संस्थान ने नवंबर 2026 में "SOUL AI" स्मार्ट लाइब्रेरी असिस्टेंट प्रारंभ किया?
o: छत्रपति शाहू जी महाराज विश्वविद्यालय, कानपुर
e: Chhatrapati Shahu Ji Maharaj University (CSJMU), Kanpur launched the "SOUL AI" smart library assistant in November 2026 to streamline academic discovery for students and researchers.
qe: Which higher education institution in Uttar Pradesh introduced the "SOUL AI" smart library assistant in November 2026?

q: नवंबर 2026 में केंद्रीय मंत्रिमंडल ने ₹14,500 करोड़ की वायबिलिटी गैप फंडिंग (VGF) योजना मुख्य रूप से किस रणनीतिक ऊर्जा क्षेत्र हेतु स्वीकृत की?
e: The ₹14,500 crore VGF scheme approved in November 2026 supports Grid-Scale Energy Storage systems to stabilize renewable power supply and achieve India's 2030 clean energy targets.
qe: In November 2026, the Union Cabinet approved a ₹14,500 crore Viability Gap Funding (VGF) scheme primarily targeting which strategic energy sector?

q: उत्तर प्रदेश का कौन-सा नगर "इत्र नगरी" के रूप में प्रसिद्ध है और सम्राट हर्षवर्धन की राजधानी रहा था?
e: Kannauj (ancient Kanyakubja / Mahodaya) is renowned for traditional Attar distillation (ODOP) and was Harsha's capital in the 7th century CE. Exam Boosters: (1) Jaunpur was called "Shiraz-e-Hind" under the Sharqi Dynasty (Atala Masjid).
qe: Which city of Uttar Pradesh is celebrated as the "City of Perfume" (इत्र नगरी) and served as Emperor Harshavardhana's imperial capital?

q: उत्तर प्रदेश में "नरौरा परमाणु विद्युत संयंत्र" (NAPS) गंगा के तट पर किस जिले में स्थित है?
e: Narora Atomic Power Station (commissioned 1991, two PHWR units of 220 MW each) is located in Bulandshahr district of Uttar Pradesh. Exam Boosters: (1) Other nuclear plants in India: Tarapur (Maharashtra — oldest, 1969), Rawatbhata (Rajasthan), Kalpakkam & Kudankulam (TN), Kaiga (Karnataka), Kakrapar (Gujarat).
qe: In Uttar Pradesh, the "Narora Atomic Power Station" (NAPS) is located on the banks of the Ganga in which district?

q: उत्तर प्रदेश का कौन-सा शास्त्रीय संगीत घराना शहनाई वादक उस्ताद बिस्मिल्लाह खाँ तथा तबला वादक पंडित किशन महाराज से संबंधित है?
e: Ustad Bismillah Khan (Bharat Ratna 2001), Pandit Kishan Maharaj, Girija Devi (Thumri queen), and Pandit Ravi Shankar are icons of the Banaras Gharana. Exam Boosters: (1) Kirana Gharana (Shamli, UP): Abdul Karim Khan, Pandit Bhimsen Joshi. (2) Lucknow Gharana: Birju Maharaj (Kathak).
qe: Which classical Hindustani musical Gharana of Uttar Pradesh is associated with legendary Shehnai maestro Ustad Bismillah Khan and Tabla wizard Pandit Kishan Maharaj?

q: उत्तर प्रदेश के संबंध में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कृषि/भौगोलिक तथ्य सही नहीं है?
o: उत्तर प्रदेश 9 कृषि-जलवायु क्षेत्रों में विभाजित है
क्षेत्रफल की दृष्टि से लखीमपुर खीरी यूपी का सबसे बड़ा जिला है
क्षेत्रफल की दृष्टि से हापुड़ यूपी का सबसे छोटा जिला है
जनसंख्या की दृष्टि से प्रयागराज यूपी का सबसे छोटा जिला है
e: Prayagraj is the MOST populous district of UP (Census 2011), while Mahoba has the LOWEST population in UP! Options A, B, and C are all completely accurate.
qe: Which of the following agricultural/geographical facts about Uttar Pradesh is NOT correct?
oe: UP is divided into 9 Agro-Climatic Zones
Lakhimpur Kheri is the largest district of UP by area
Hapur is the smallest district of UP by area
Prayagraj is the district with the lowest population in UP

q: यूपी बजट 2026–27 के तहत राज्य सरकार ने पुत्री विवाह अनुदान को दोगुना कर ₹1 लाख किया और युवाओं के रोजगार हेतु कौन-सा विशेष मिशन शुरू किया?
e: UP Budget 2026–27 highlighted the UP Employment Mission (उत्तर प्रदेश रोजगार मिशन) for organized domestic and overseas youth employment alongside doubling the Daughter's Marriage Grant from ₹50,000 to ₹1,00,000.
qe: Under the UP Budget 2026–27, the state government doubled the grant under the Daughter's Marriage Grant Scheme (पुत्री विवाह अनुदान योजना) to ₹1 lakh and launched which dedicated mission for youth placement?

q: 1828 में "ब्रह्म समाज" की स्थापना किसने की और 1829 में सती प्रथा उन्मूलन के अभियान का नेतृत्व किया?
e: Raja Ram Mohan Roy ("Father of Indian Renaissance", given title 'Raja' by Mughal Emperor Akbar II) founded Brahmo Sabha/Samaj in August 1828 and aided Lord William Bentinck in passing Bengal Sati Regulation XVII of 1829.
qe: Who was the founder of the "Brahmo Samaj" (1828) and spearheaded the campaign leading to the abolition of Sati in 1829?

q: 1924 में कानपुर में रामप्रसाद बिस्मिल, शचींद्रनाथ सान्याल और जोगेश चंद्र चटर्जी द्वारा किस क्रांतिकारी संगठन की स्थापना की गई थी?
e: The HRA was founded in October 1924 at Kanpur (later reorganized as HSRA in September 1928 at Feroz Shah Kotla, Delhi by Bhagat Singh and Chandrashekhar Azad). Exam Boosters: (1) Ghadar Party: 1913, San Francisco (Lala Hardayal, Sohan Singh Bhakna). (2) Abhinav Bharat: 1904, V. D. Savarkar.
qe: Which revolutionary organization was founded in 1924 at Kanpur by Ram Prasad Bismil, Sachindra Nath Sanyal, and Jogesh Chandra Chatterjee?

q: भारत में महात्मा गांधी का प्रथम सविनय अवज्ञा आंदोलन "चंपारण सत्याग्रह" (1917) किस शोषणकारी नील खेती प्रणाली को समाप्त करने हेतु शुरू किया गया था?
e: Under the Tinkathia system in Champaran (Bihar), peasants were forced to grow indigo on 3/20th of their land. Invited by Rajkumar Shukla, Gandhi led the Satyagraha (with Rajendra Prasad, Brajkishore Prasad, J. B. Kripalani), leading to abolition of Tinkathia and 25% refund.
qe: The "Champaran Satyagraha" (1917), Mahatma Gandhi's first Civil Disobedience movement in India, was launched to abolish which exploitative indigo cultivation system?

q:
भारत शासन अधिनियम, 1935 के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: इसने प्रांतों में द्वैध शासन समाप्त कर प्रांतीय स्वायत्तता लागू की तथा केंद्र में द्वैध शासन का प्रावधान किया।
कथन II: इसने एक संघीय न्यायालय (1937 में स्थापित) तथा भारतीय रिज़र्व बैंक की स्थापना का प्रावधान किया।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन-सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
o: न तो I और न ही II
e: Both statements are accurate. The 1935 Act also introduced bicameralism in 6 out of 11 provinces (including United Provinces), separated Burma from India (1937), and serves as the structural blueprint for India's 1950 Constitution.
qe:
Consider the following statements regarding the Government of India Act, 1935:
Statement I: It abolished dyarchy in the provinces and introduced provincial autonomy, while providing for dyarchy at the Centre.
Statement II: It provided for the establishment of a Federal Court (set up in 1937) and the Reserve Bank of India.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?

q: 1916 के भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस के ऐतिहासिक लखनऊ अधिवेशन की अध्यक्षता किसने की थी, जिसमें नरमदल-गरमदल का एकीकरण तथा कांग्रेस-मुस्लिम लीग के बीच "लखनऊ समझौता" हुआ?
e: Ambica Charan Mazumdar presided over the December 1916 Lucknow Session. Tilak and Annie Besant played pivotal roles in bridging the Surat Split (1907) and brokering the Lucknow Pact with Jinnah.
qe: Who presided over the historic 1916 Lucknow Session of the Indian National Congress, which witnessed both the reunion of Moderates & Extremists and the Congress–Muslim League "Lucknow Pact"?

q: अनुच्छेद 24 के अंतर्गत कौन-सा मौलिक अधिकार 14 वर्ष से कम आयु के बच्चों को किसी कारखाने, खान या अन्य जोखिमपूर्ण कार्य में नियोजित करने पर प्रतिबंध लगाता है?
e: Articles 23 (prohibition of human trafficking and forced labour/begar) and 24 (prohibition of child labour under age 14) constitute the Right against Exploitation.
qe: Which Fundamental Right under Article 24 prohibits the employment of children below the age of 14 years in any factory, mine, or other hazardous employment?

q: शिक्षा का अधिकार (RTE) अधिनियम, 2009 के अंतर्गत प्रारंभिक विद्यालयों (कक्षा 1–8) में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी प्रथा पूर्णतः निषिद्ध है?
o: शारीरिक दंड, मानसिक उत्पीड़न व कैपिटेशन शुल्क
प्राथमिक कक्षाओं हेतु न्यूनतम 200 कार्य दिवस
e: Section 13 prohibits capitation fees and screening procedures, and Section 17 strictly bans physical punishment and mental harassment of children. SMCs (Section 21) and minimum 200/220 instructional days are mandatory positive provisions.
qe: Under the Right to Education (RTE) Act, 2009, which of the following practices is strictly PROHIBITED in elementary schools (Classes 1–8)?
oe: Physical punishment, mental harassment, and capitation fees
Maintaining minimum 200 working days for primary classes

q: भारतीय संविधान का कौन-सा अनुच्छेद राष्ट्रपति द्वारा "भाषाई अल्पसंख्यकों के लिए विशेष अधिकारी" की नियुक्ति का प्रावधान करता है?
e: Inserted by the 7th Constitutional Amendment Act, 1956 (on recommendation of States Reorganisation Commission), Article 350B provides for the Commissioner for Linguistic Minorities (headquartered at Prayagraj, UP!). Exam Boosters: (1) Art 350A (also 7th Amendment) mandates mother-tongue instruction at the primary stage.
qe: Which Article of the Indian Constitution provides for the appointment of a "Special Officer for Linguistic Minorities" by the President?

q: भारतीय संसदीय प्रणाली में "शून्य काल" (Zero Hour) किसके तुरंत बाद प्रारंभ होता है?
e: Question Hour is the first hour of a parliamentary sitting (11:00 AM–12:00 PM), immediately followed by Zero Hour (12:00 PM onwards), where MPs raise urgent public matters without prior notice.
qe: In the Indian parliamentary system, the "Zero Hour" (शून्य काल) begins immediately after:

q: किस ऐतिहासिक निर्णय में सर्वोच्च न्यायालय ने "संविधान के मूल ढाँचे का सिद्धांत" प्रतिपादित किया कि संसद अनुच्छेद 368 के तहत संविधान की आधारभूत पहचान नहीं बदल सकती?
e: On 24 April 1973, the largest-ever 13-judge Constitution Bench in Kesavananda Bharati v. State of Kerala (7:6 majority, led by CJI S. M. Sikri) propounded the Basic Structure Doctrine.
qe: In which landmark judgment did the Supreme Court lay down the "Basic Structure Doctrine" (संविधान का मूल ढाँचा सिद्धांत), holding that Parliament cannot alter the fundamental identity of the Constitution under Article 368?

q: किस नदी को प्रसिद्ध रूप से "दक्षिण गंगा" कहा जाता है और जो प्रायद्वीपीय भारत की सबसे लंबी नदी है?
e: The Godavari (1,465 km, originating from Trimbakeshwar near Nashik, Maharashtra) is the longest peninsular river and is called Dakshin Ganga / Vridha Ganga. (Kaveri is often called "Ganga of South India" for its sacredness.)
qe: Which river is famously known as the "Dakshin Ganga" (Ganga of the South) and is the longest river of Peninsular India?

q: "दस डिग्री चैनल" (Ten Degree Channel) भारत के किन दो द्वीप समूहों को अलग करता है?
e: The 10° N Channel separates the Andaman Islands (Little Andaman) from the Nicobar Islands (Car Nicobar). Exam Boosters: (1) 8° Channel: Minicoy & Maldives; (2) 9° Channel: Lakshadweep & Minicoy; (3) Duncan Passage: South Andaman & Little Andaman.
qe: The "Ten Degree Channel" (दस डिग्री चैनल) separates which two island groups of India?

q: जनगणना 2011 के अनुसार, भारत के किस राज्य में शहरी जनसंख्या का प्रतिशत सर्वाधिक था तथा किस राज्य में कुल ग्रामीण जनसंख्या सर्वाधिक थी?
e: As per Census 2011, Goa was the most urbanized state by percentage (62.17%), followed by Mizoram (52.11%) and Tamil Nadu (48.40%). Uttar Pradesh had the largest absolute rural population (~15.53 crore), while Himachal Pradesh had the highest rural percentage (89.97%).
qe: According to Census 2011, which state of India had the HIGHEST percentage of urban population, and which state had the HIGHEST total rural population?

q: किस संस्था को "अंतिम ऋणदाता" (Lender of Last Resort) तथा भारत के विदेशी मुद्रा भंडार का संरक्षक कहा जाता है?
e: The Reserve Bank of India (established 1 April 1935 under RBI Act 1934 on Hilton Young Commission's recommendation; nationalized 1 January 1949) is India's central bank, lender of last resort, and forex custodian.
qe: Which institution is known as the "Lender of Last Resort" and the custodian of India's foreign exchange reserves?

q: भारत के केंद्रीय बजट में "राजकोषीय घाटा" (Fiscal Deficit) किसे दर्शाता है?
o: कुल व्यय घटाव उधार को छोड़कर कुल प्राप्तियाँ
e: Fiscal Deficit = Total Expenditure − (Revenue Receipts + Non-Debt Creating Capital Receipts), indicating the government's total borrowing requirement. Exam Boosters: (1) Revenue Deficit = Option A; (2) Primary Deficit = Fiscal Deficit − Interest Payments (Option C).
qe: What does "Fiscal Deficit" (राजकोषीय घाटा) represent in the Union Budget of India?
oe: Total Expenditure minus Total Receipts excluding borrowings

q: समष्टि अर्थशास्त्र में "फिलिप्स वक्र" (Phillips Curve) किन दो आर्थिक चरों के बीच अल्पकालिक व्युत्क्रम संबंध को दर्शाता है?
o: कर की दर और सरकारी कर राजस्व
मुद्रास्फीति की दर और बेरोजगारी की दर
e: The Phillips Curve (A. W. Phillips, 1958) shows an inverse trade-off between inflation and unemployment in the short run. Exam Boosters: (1) Laffer Curve: Tax rate vs Tax revenue (Option A). (2) Kuznets Curve: Economic growth vs Income inequality (Option C).
qe: The "Phillips Curve" in macroeconomics illustrates an inverse short-run relationship between which two economic variables?
oe: Tax rate and Government tax revenue
Rate of inflation and Rate of unemployment

q: समतापमंडलीय ओजोन परत के क्षरण के लिए मुख्य रूप से कौन-सी गैस उत्तरदायी है?
e: Chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs) and halons release reactive chlorine/bromine radicals under UV light that break down ozone (O₃) molecules. Exam Boosters: (1) Montreal Protocol (signed 16 September 1987) successfully phased out ozone-depleting substances; 16 September is World Ozone Day. (2) Ozone thickness is measured in Dobson Units (DU).
qe: Which gas is primarily responsible for the depletion of the stratospheric Ozone Layer (ओजोन परत)?

q: किस कोशिकांग को "कोशिका का ऊर्जाघर" (Powerhouse of the Cell) कहा जाता है क्योंकि यह कोशिकीय श्वसन द्वारा ATP उत्पन्न करता है?
e: Mitochondria synthesize ATP (Adenosine Triphosphate) via oxidative phosphorylation and possess their own circular DNA. Exam Boosters: (1) Ribosome: Protein factory; (2) Lysosome: Suicidal bag of the cell; (3) Chloroplast: Kitchen of plant cells.
qe: Which cell organelle is known as the "Powerhouse of the Cell" because it generates ATP through cellular respiration?

q: शैक्षिक प्रौद्योगिकी एवं कंप्यूटिंग में "क्लाउड कंप्यूटिंग" (जैसे गूगल वर्कस्पेस या माइक्रोसॉफ्ट 365 जैसी SaaS सेवाएँ) क्या है?
o: स्थानीय सर्वर प्रबंधन के बिना इंटरनेट पर कंप्यूटिंग संसाधनों, स्टोरेज व सॉफ्टवेयर की ऑन-डिमांड आपूर्ति
ऑप्टिकल डिस्क द्वारा ऑफलाइन सॉफ्टवेयर स्थापित करना
वायुमंडलीय उपग्रह सेंसर द्वारा मौसम पूर्वानुमान
इंटरनेट के बिना केवल ब्लूटूथ से दो कंप्यूटर जोड़ना
e: Cloud computing provides on-demand internet-based access to servers, databases, storage, and software across three main service models: IaaS (Infrastructure), PaaS (Platform), and SaaS (Software as a Service).
qe: In educational technology and computing, what is "Cloud Computing" (e.g., SaaS like Google Workspace / Microsoft 365)?
oe: On-demand delivery of computing resources, storage, and software over the internet without local server management
Installing offline open-source software via physical optical discs
Weather forecasting using atmospheric satellite sensors
Connecting two computers exclusively through Bluetooth without internet
